name: Novaja igrushka Govarda
source:
You share a house with two talking animals. A humble dog and a cocky cat called Howard Fluffcraft. What happens, when a cat brings home an ancient relic? Nobody knows, except the cosmic Gods.

[From [url=https://gargoolia.itch.io/howards-new-toy-eng]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和两只会说话的动物住在一起：一只朴实的狗，以及一只自大的猫，名叫Howard Fluffcraft。猫带回一件古老遗物后会发生什么？没人知道，只有宇宙众神知晓。

[来源：[url=https://gargoolia.itch.io/howards-new-toy-eng]Itch.io[/url]]
